title: Three-source capture-recapture for the finders' recall
label: Exploratory; not a test of H1-H10. Seen creators only. Model-coded labels, not checked by a person; agreement (consistency), never accuracy.
agnosticism: No measure in this study can tell whether a non-human source speaks; every measure describes the speech in these recordings and how the creators present it.
reading: forecast F1 statements: admissible three-source range 0.786 to 0.876 (upper end 90% 0.650 to 0.927) against nlp-R13's 0.991: optimistic by at least the margin; forecast candidates: only the zero-df all-two-way model is admissible (0.097, unstable), reading by rule 'optimistic by at least the margin' with a caveat; asks any class: no admissible three-source model (two-capture Chapman 0.997); asks K1: described only (Chapman 1.000)
interval: 90% creator-cluster bootstrap, percentile; flagged: interval method not calibrated by r3-P30 for this design class
departures: asks any-class row compared with nlp-R13's registered asks-of-record row (clarification 3, written before analysis)
small cells: only the ends of the admissible range and the two-capture recall printed (clarification 4)
not_stored: a third capture on the whole seen roster (the three-source estimate rests on set G)
